authorization: Founder approved surgical direct ClientApp release to stop AADSTS50020 caused by entering Microsoft OIDC without the canonical client identity preflight.
purpose: Direct release only ClientApp. Require the existing member sign-in preflight to run before any non-support Microsoft OIDC challenge when no protected continuation exists. This reuses the existing ClientIdentityAccessService and Entra lifecycle authority so active clients are synchronized/provisioned and sent through guest redemption when required. Do not modify subscription activation, Square payments, billing orchestration, subscription management, database schema, AgentPortal, Protect, Parfait, or LEGEND Website. ClientApp-only package gating is corrected to key directly from the selected target set after successful build/tests/web checks so a validated ClientApp candidate cannot be skipped before Azure deployment.
